# SPage `<s-page>`

The top-level page layout, with a heading, page actions and content areas. `SPage` is the typed Vue 3 wrapper for Shopify's Polaris `<s-page>` web component.

```ts
import { SPage } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Best practices

- **Give every page a title.** Set `heading` to a title that describes the page the merchant is on.
- **Add breadcrumbs inside a flow.** When the page is one step in a larger flow, put links back in the `breadcrumb-actions` slot.
- **Keep header actions page-wide.** Only place actions in the header when they apply to the whole page, not to one part of it.
- **Limit the number of actions.** Use at most one primary action and three secondary actions on a page.
- **Leave the bottom of the page free of actions.** Don't place any actions at the end of the page.

```vue
<SPage heading="Edit product">
  <template #breadcrumb-actions>
    <SLink href="/products">Products</SLink>
  </template>
  <template #primary-action>
    <SButton variant="primary">Save</SButton>
  </template>
  <template #secondary-actions>
    <SButton>Duplicate</SButton>
    <SButton>Archive</SButton>
  </template>
  <!-- … -->
</SPage>
```

See [Shopify's best practices for `<s-page>`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/layout-and-structure/page#best-practices) for the full guidance.

```vue
<script setup>
import { SPage, SSection, SParagraph, SButton } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
</script>

<template>
  <SPage heading="Orders">
    <template #primary-action>
      <SButton variant="primary">Create order</SButton>
    </template>

    <SSection heading="Recent activity">
      <SParagraph>No orders have been placed yet.</SParagraph>
    </SSection>
  </SPage>
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | `string` | The main page heading |
| `inlineSize` | `"base" \| "small" \| "large"` | The inline size of the page - `base` corresponds to a set default inline size - `large` full width with whitespace |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The main page content displayed within the page component, which serves as the primary container for the page's information and interface elements. |
| `aside` | The content to display in the aside section of the page. This slot is only rendered when `inlineSize` is "base". |
| `breadcrumb-actions` | The navigation back actions for the page. Only accepts link components. |
| `primary-action` | The primary action for the page. Only accepts a single button component with a `variant` of `primary`. |
| `secondary-actions` | The secondary actions for the page. Only accepts button group and button components with a `variant` of `secondary` or `auto`. |
| `supplemental-start` | A slot for content that comes before the main content, such as an `s-banner`. |
